title: Service Deck
description: Structured description of one Sunday's non-sermon service slides. The model emits this; scripts/build-deck.js renders the HTML. Everything mechanical (slide numbering, backgrounds, scrims, seasons, stanza splitting, escaping) is the script's job, NOT the model's.

date.description: Service date. Drives the default output path (passages/YYYY-MM-DD/service-preview.html) and the default season.

season.description: Optional override for the seasonal background variants. Default is derived from the month of `date`: Dec-Feb winter, Mar-May spring, Jun-Aug summer, Sep-Nov fall.

notes.description: Free-text operator note. Never rendered onto a slide; echoed in the report.

segments.description: The running order, in order. Each segment expands to one or more slides.

background.description: Optional override of the segment's default background. A bare filename in templates/service/ (e.g. "praise-2.png"). The file must exist.

scrim.description: Optional override of the automatic scrim. By default a scrim is emitted only for the bright/busy backgrounds (choir.png, baptism.png, graduation.png).

count.description: How many identical preshow slides to emit.

prelude.description: prelude.png. 1 song-title slide (title only, no hymn number). Lyrics are never emitted for a prelude.

song.description: Song slug in songs/ (filename without .md). Used only for its title.

title.description: Literal title, when the piece is not in the song library. One of `song` or `title` is required.

performer.description: Optional performer, shown under the title.

names.description: Name(s) being baptized. Joined with ' & '. If absent, the slide reads "Baptism".

song.description: Hymn / congregational / invitation. Title slide + one lyric slide per section (the script splits an over-long stanza across slides). Lyrics are ALWAYS pulled from songs/<slug>.md — never supplied inline.
Song slug in songs/ (filename without .md). Required.

role.description: Overrides the song's frontmatter `type` for background selection. hymn/invitation -> hymn-1.png + hymn number; praise -> praise-1.png / praise-2.png alternating across the deck, no number.

sections.description: Ordered list of `## Section` headings to project, repeats and all (e.g. ["Verse 1","Refrain","Verse 2","Refrain"]). Omit for all sections in file order. Every name must exist in the song file or the build fails.

number.description: Overrides the hymnal number from frontmatter.

font_size.description: Override the fitted lyric font size, in px. The script normally picks the largest size (60 down to a 48px floor) at which every written line stays whole, because wrapping a hymn line mid-phrase strands words on the wall. Set this only when that call is wrong — e.g. you would rather have smaller text than a re-broken line. Reported under `typography`.

title_only.description: Emit the title slide but no lyric slides (e.g. lyrics not yet confirmed). Reported under `missing`.

specialMusic.description: choir.png + scrim. 1 song-title slide with title + performer. Lyrics are NEVER pulled from the library for special music; pass them inline if the operator supplied them.

song.description: Song slug, used only for its title. One of `song` or `title` is required.

performer.description: e.g. "The Lovette Quartet", "Calvary Choir". Absent -> reported under `missing`.

font_size.description: Override the fitted lyric font size, in px. The script normally picks the largest size (60 down to a 48px floor) at which every written line stays whole, because wrapping a hymn line mid-phrase strands words on the wall. Set this only when that call is wrong — e.g. you would rather have smaller text than a re-broken line. Reported under `typography`.

lyrics.description: Optional operator-supplied stanzas. Each item is one stanza: either a string with newlines, or an array of lines.

sermonTransition.description: black.png. 1 plain slide. Goes in EVERY deck, between the last pre-sermon music and the sermon — the screen the congregation looks at while the pastor comes up. If the service has a video here, it is dropped in later outside this deck; the black slide is its slot, so a video does NOT add a second segment.

label.description: Preview-chrome label only. Nothing is rendered on the slide.

video.description: black.png. 1 plain slide. An explicit extra video slot; the pre-sermon black slide is `sermon_transition`, not this.
